service_version: setup-service/1.0 (hand-drafted in the service schema from a full local census; no API calls, no LLM drafting)
drafted_for: Second-domain pilot P0 (issue #26): generalization proof per docs/SECOND_DOMAIN_PILOT.md — pre-registered criteria bind (CUAD thresholds pinned, profile+config only, no pipeline code changes).

sampling.rule: no sampling — full-corpus census of all three splits (Train 400 / Dev 100 / Test 100)

inventory.passage_structure: passage 0 = title, passage 1 = abstract; no section structure beyond inline structured-abstract labels (e.g. 'OBJECTIVE:')

gold: BioC JSON at data/biored/BioRED/{Train,Dev,Test}.BioC.JSON: passage-level entity annotations (type + database identifier infons) and document-level pair relations (endpoint gold IDs + type + novel flag). Gold identifiers are EVALUATION-ONLY under DP-B1 (pending approval).

claims.statement: The BioRED family holds 600 documents (Train 400 / Dev 100 / Test 100), exactly 2 passages each (title + abstract), 999,922 chars total; PMIDs are disjoint across splits.

Gold holds 20,419 entity mentions across 6 types (GeneOrGeneProduct, DiseaseOrPhenotypicFeature, ChemicalEntity, OrganismTaxon, SequenceVariant, CellLine) and 6,503 document-level pair relations across 8 types; 99.69% of mentions carry a gold database identifier (NCBI Gene / MeSH / NCBI Taxonomy / dbSNP / HGVS / Cellosaurus).

Association is 52.1% of gold relations and spans nearly every endpoint type pair; zero gold relations have an OrganismTaxon or CellLine endpoint; gold endpoint order is attested in both directions and is not semantic.

Abbreviation density is high (81.7% of docs define >=1 short form in parentheses; 861 gold-attested in-doc multi-surface IDs) while surface ambiguity is also high (302 surfaces -> >1 gold ID; 103 case-fold collision groups). Case in gene symbols encodes species and must be preserved.

529 mentions carry a comma-separated list of gold IDs (gene-family/group mentions). Every relation endpoint resolves to an in-document annotation once lists are split into components; zero endpoints are ungrounded.

decision_points.topic: gold database identifiers — build input or evaluation key
decision_points.question: 99.69% of BioRED mentions carry a gold database identifier (NCBI Gene, MeSH, NCBI Taxonomy, dbSNP/HGVS, Cellosaurus). May the build use them, or are they evaluation-only?
options: A: Evaluation-only — the build sees surfaces and text only; gold IDs are the sealed scoring key.
B: Build-time canonical anchor — ER resolved by gold-ID lookup.
C: Hybrid — build blind, but gold IDs may break ties inside the ER review band.
decision_points.evidence: With gold IDs as anchors, ER becomes a lookup: the G-33 guard and the Jev ER gate are never exercised and the pilot proves nothing about transfer — and production corpora do not ship gold IDs. C leaks through the review band, which is exactly where ER is decided. Kept sealed, the IDs buy something CUAD never had: every ER decision in the slice can be scored exactly (precision AND recall over merges), no sampling.

decision_points.question: Which of the six gold entity types are in extraction scope?
options: A: All six (GeneOrGeneProduct, DiseaseOrPhenotypicFeature, ChemicalEntity, OrganismTaxon, SequenceVariant, CellLine).
B: Only the four types that carry relations (drop OrganismTaxon and CellLine).
C: All six, but CellLine deferred to a later batch.
decision_points.recommendation: A: all six extracted (OrganismTaxon's graph role is decided separately in DP-B3). Dropping gold types at extraction would silently bias every recall accounting against gold; CellLine is small (175 mentions) but costs nothing to include.
decision_points.evidence: Census counts: Gene 6,697 / Disease 5,545 / Chemical 4,429 / OrganismTaxon 2,192 / SequenceVariant 1,381 / CellLine 175 mentions; all six types have >=99.4% identifier coverage.

decision_points.question: Species determines gene identity (human BRCA1 is not mouse Brca1), but should OrganismTaxon be minted as a first-class graph entity?
options: A: Qualifier only — extracted and recorded as species context on gene/variant mentions (an ER feature), never minted as an entity, never a relation endpoint.
B: Full entity in the graph like any other type.
C: Dropped entirely (not extracted).
decision_points.recommendation: A: qualifier. Gold itself never uses a taxon as a relation endpoint (0 of 6,503 relations), so a taxon node would carry no relational content — it would be a pure hub. Extraction still records it, and taxon recall is reported as a qualifier metric so the accounting against gold stays honest.
decision_points.evidence: Only 47 distinct taxon IDs across 600 docs; human+mouse+rat = 92% of 2,192 mentions; the most-mentioned gold ID in the corpus is 9606 'human' (1,364 mentions) whose surfaces are generic words ('patients', 'patient', 'man', 'woman'). As entities these are mega-hubs — the G-29 hub failure mode — with zero gold relations attached.

decision_points.question: Association is 3,387 of 6,503 gold relations (52.1%) and is semantically a catch-all ('some relation holds'). How is it treated?
options: A: First-class relation, Tier-1 eligible, pooled silently into the headline precision.
B: First-class and Tier-1 eligible, but flagged (specificity: generic) and reported separately — the P2 audit headline is stated with and without Association.
C: Excluded from Tier-1 eligibility (all Association demoted to Tier 2).
decision_points.recommendation: B: keep, flag, split the reporting. The Jev gate judges attestation, not semantic specificity — an attested-but-vague triple is still a true triple. Excluding 52% of gold would make recall-vs-gold meaningless and hide the hardest judging problem; pooling it silently would let a vague relation inflate the precision headline.
decision_points.evidence: Association spans nearly every endpoint type pair (Disease~Gene 1,419; Gene~Gene 580; Disease~Variant 483; Chemical~Gene 317) — it is the annotation default bucket, not a specific claim type.

decision_points.question: Are the 8 gold relation types directional (A->B distinct from B->A)?
options: A: Undirected — Tier-1 identity is the canonical unordered pair + type; gold endpoint order is preserved in provenance only.
B: Directional as annotated — reversed pairs are distinct triples.
decision_points.recommendation: A: undirected. Gold attests both orders for the same relation types across the corpus, and 24 Association + 19 Positive_Correlation unordered pairs appear in BOTH orders — order is annotation serialization, not semantics. Treating pairs as directional would double-count reversed duplicates and corrupt QA construction.
decision_points.evidence: Pair-signature census: e.g. Positive_Correlation attests Variant~Disease and Disease~Variant in comparable numbers (Dev: 49 vs 48). Cotreatment / Drug_Interaction / Comparison are symmetric by definition; Conversion (n=4) follows the uniform convention, declared here.

decision_points.question: CUAD's approved profile case-folds titles and applies fuzzy matching. Does any of that carry to BioRED surfaces?
options: A: Case preserved exactly; matching normalizes only whitespace, hyphen variants, and Greek-letter spellings. No case-fold, no case-insensitive fuzzy merge. Case is a feature for the ER scorer, never a pre-merge.
B: Case-fold like CUAD for surface matching, case kept as a tiebreaker.
decision_points.recommendation: A. In this corpus case is the species signal in gene symbols — folding it away merges different genes. CUAD point 6 (case-fold + fuzzy for OCR/caps titles) does NOT carry over; abstracts are clean born-digital text with no OCR problem to solve.
decision_points.evidence: 103 case-folded surface groups map to >1 surface AND >1 gold ID: human CCL2 (NCBI Gene 6347) vs mouse Ccl2 (20296) vs rat Ccl2 (24770); PTPN22 (human 26191) vs Ptpn22 (mouse 19260). Gene casing: ALLCAPS 53%, mixed 22%, lowercase 16%, Capitalized 8%.

decision_points.question: How do short forms (abbreviations, symbols) bind to full names?
options: A: Abstract-local only — a short form binds via a definition chain attested in the same abstract, or via Jev-gated ER; otherwise it stays its own surface (review band). No global symbol table.
B: Global symbol table built from the corpus's definition chains, applied across abstracts.
C: External dictionary (UMLS/MeSH) binding.
decision_points.recommendation: A — mirrors CUAD's approved per-document alias chains and fiction DP-F2 (text-attested only). A global table (B) bakes in wrong bindings because the same short form denotes different entities in different abstracts; C imports outside knowledge the certified method does not use.
decision_points.evidence: 490/600 docs (81.7%) contain >=1 parenthetical definition (1,325 total); gold attests 861 in-document cases of one ID with multiple surfaces incl. a short form. But 302 surfaces map to >1 gold ID corpus-wide ('insulin' -> 7 IDs; 'CA3' -> a cell line and a gene), so cross-document symbol reuse is unsafe by default.

decision_points.topic: ER scope & the G-33 guard under legitimate recurrence
decision_points.question: In CUAD, cross-document merges were the exception and mostly wrong (defined terms are per-document). In BioRED the same gene/disease legitimately recurs across abstracts. What is the ER scope and guard stance?
options: A: One corpus-level registry (namespace 'biored'); cross-document merging is expected and in-scope; the G-33 guard stays PINNED (cross-doc auto-merge only at Jev ER p_same >= 0.85, else review band) — whether 0.85 holds under dense legitimate recurrence is part of the transfer test.
B: Per-document entities only (no cross-doc merge), corpus graph assembled at query time.
C: Cross-doc auto-merge at a lowered threshold for this corpus (e.g. 0.70) because recurrence is usually legitimate.
decision_points.recommendation: A. B abandons the corpus-graph claim the pilot exists to test; C retunes a pinned threshold mid-pilot, which the pre-registered criteria forbid — if 0.85 misbehaves, that is declared a finding, not silently adjusted. The gold IDs make ER exactly measurable here (DP-B1), so the guard's behavior will be visible in full, not sampled.
decision_points.evidence: 879 gold IDs recur in >=2 documents, 44 in >=10; only 3,083 of 3,962 IDs are singletons. Recurrence is the norm, but so are the traps: 302 ambiguous surfaces and 103 case-collision groups sit in the same corpus.

decision_points.question: Which split is the P1 working slice?
options: A: Dev 100 as the working slice; Test 100 sealed untouched; Train untouched during P1-P3.
B: A 100-doc Train slice (Dev kept as validation).
C: All 600 docs (no held-out set).
decision_points.recommendation: A: Dev. It is large enough for the ~100-item audit pack and ~100-question QA (1,162 gold relations, 3,533 mentions), and Test stays pristine for a later confirmatory run — a luxury CUAD never had (its whole corpus was the working set). Declared caveat: Dev holds zero Conversion and zero Drug_Interaction gold relations (Bind only 19), so rare-type behavior is unmeasurable on Dev and will be reported as such in P1.
decision_points.evidence: Splits are PMID-disjoint (overlap 0, verified). Dev: 100 docs / 172,553 chars / 1,162 relations. Train holds all 8 relation types (Conversion 3, Drug_Interaction 11) if a rare-type follow-up is ever approved.

decision_points.topic: P3 QA construction protocol & contamination guard
decision_points.question: BioRED has no native QA. How is the P3 question set built, and how is it kept uncontaminated?
options: A: Questions generated from Dev gold relations by a builder who has not seen pipeline output; the QA file is frozen and hashed BEFORE the P1 batch runs; answers are never edited after seeing arm outputs (corrections only via the ruling process, as with the CUAD QA).
B: QA built after the P1 run, from gold, by the same operator who ran the batch.
C: QA generated by an LLM from the abstracts, spot-checked by a human.
decision_points.recommendation: A. Protocol sketch: (1) source = Dev gold relations whose endpoints are both mentioned in the abstract passage (1,098 of 1,162 by span class, more after multi-ID splitting); (2) one templated question per sampled relation, keyed to relation type + endpoint types (e.g. Negative_Correlation Chemical~Disease: 'Which disease is reported to be reduced or inhibited by <chemical surface as attested in the abstract>?'); (3) answer = the gold endpoint's most frequent in-document surface, with the gold ID recorded as the scoring key; (4) ~100 questions, relation-type distribution = natural share, declared in the QA doc; (5) scored recall@20, four arms, production query path — the CUAD protocol unchanged.
decision_points.evidence: The CUAD headline QA (116 q) was built the same way — from gold, frozen before scoring. Option B lets run knowledge leak into question choice; C makes the QA itself an LLM artifact whose errors are indistinguishable from retrieval errors.

decision_points.question: CUAD's profile carries 41 clause-slot categories. BioRED gold has entities + pair relations only. What is the extraction configuration?
options: A: Triples-only — label_categories = [] (the fiction-profile pattern); the proposer extracts the 8 gold relation types between the 6 entity types; no slot design work in this pilot.
B: Design a biomedical slot layer (e.g. dosage, direction-of-effect as slots) before P1.
decision_points.recommendation: A: triples-only. There is no slot analog in the gold, so any slot layer would be unscored invention — exactly what the setup service must not do (the CUAD c1_whitelist rule). Consequence to declare: the P2 audit pack has triples + ER strata only; the design doc's mention of a slot stratum is empty by construction for this domain. The relation whitelist (c1_whitelist) is derived from the first batch's relation census per playbook Part B #6, not invented here.
decision_points.evidence: BioRED annotation schema = passage-level entity annotations + document-level pair relations; no attribute/value annotations exist in any of the 600 documents (census-verified).

spend.note: local census + hand drafting; no API calls

setup_config.c1_whitelist_note: per-corpus: derive from the relation census of the first batch (playbook Part B #6); setup does not invent it
setup_config.label_categories_note: BioRED has no slot/attribute schema in gold; triples-only configuration per DP-B11 (pending approval).
setup_config.thresholds_note: All thresholds PINNED from the certified CUAD configuration per the pilot's pre-registered criteria; any retuning is a declared finding, never a silent adjustment.
